m1NetIssueEditionSnapshot.interpretationEn: Historical snapshot on the merged M1 tree. External owner sign-off and merge bound that Head. The boolean does not reopen the merge. CR-2026-009 accepted 664P3-1 as this M2 input edition; 664P7 remains recorded and AFDX stays unselected.
m1NetIssueEditionSnapshot.interpretationZh: 已合并 M1 树上的历史快照。外部所有者签署与合并绑定了该 Head。该布尔值不重开合并。CR-2026-009 接受 664P3-1 作为本 M2 输入版次；664P7 保持已登记且 AFDX 未选。

observationBoundary.eventMappingEn: NETWORK-VISIBLE events are TFTP opcodes on a named file role. LUR is a TFTP write: DL WRQ, TH ACK, DL DATA. APPLICATION payload.decision is a typed ENUM evaluated in the guard before lastDecision is written. PARSE-RESULT/LOCAL events are derived from received files or local analysis and are not additional wire opcodes. ENVIRONMENT timeouts and WAIT-elapsed are enabled only by COMPARE(enablingCompare) of enablingClock and enablingBound.
observationBoundary.eventMappingZh: NETWORK-VISIBLE 事件是具名文件角色上的 TFTP 操作码。LUR 是 TFTP 写：数据加载器 WRQ、目标硬件 ACK、数据加载器 DATA。APPLICATION 的 payload.decision 是有类型枚举，在写入 lastDecision 之前参与守卫求值。PARSE-RESULT/LOCAL 事件由已收文件或本地分析导出，不是额外线上操作码。ENVIRONMENT 超时与 WAIT 到期仅由 enablingClock 与 enablingBound 的 COMPARE(enablingCompare) 使能。
observationBoundary.silenceRuleEn: Absence of a captured packet is not protocol silence unless the observation window, correlation key and clock are declared.
observationBoundary.silenceRuleZh: 未采到报文不是协议静默，除非已声明观测窗口、关联键和时钟。

timeSemantics.delayEn: During delay, clocks in C grow, variables in V are unchanged, and state invariants hold.
timeSemantics.discreteEn: A transition is enabled when its guard holds in the source state. Evaluation order: guard, updates, clock resets, outputs, then target. Outputs are instantaneous on the declared channel.
timeSemantics.raceEn: Timeout events compete with packet events without a forged priority. Simultaneous same-channel events are environment nondeterminism.
timeSemantics.endpointEn: Closed endpoints include equality. Unresolved bounds are not treated as unbounded.
timeSemantics.delayZh: 延时时 C 中时钟增长，V 中变量不变，状态不变量成立。
timeSemantics.discreteZh: 当守卫在源状态成立时迁移使能。求值顺序：守卫、更新、时钟复位、输出，然后进入目标。输出在声明通道上瞬时发生。
timeSemantics.raceZh: 超时事件与报文事件竞争，不伪造优先级。同一通道同时事件视为环境非确定性。
timeSemantics.endpointZh: 闭端点包含相等。未解析边界不视为无界。

scope.compositionEn: One protocol machine with two observation projections (DL, TH) sharing variables and clocks. Not two unsynchronized swimlanes.
scope.compositionZh: 一台协议机器，两个观测投影（DL、TH）共享变量与时钟，不是两张互不同步的泳道。

sourceRefinements.rationaleEn: Successor M1 delta (CR-2026-011) records CRS-M1-00143 as 6.4.4 LUR prose with HEADER-FILE. Shared object HEADER-FILE now supports a candidate 665 edge to CRS-M1-00217. Independent RG1 still required. Capability stays NOT-ESTABLISHED.
sourceRefinements.rationaleZh: 后继 M1 增量（CR-2026-011）将 CRS-M1-00143 记为 6.4.4 的 LUR 散文并含 HEADER-FILE。共享对象 HEADER-FILE 现支持到 CRS-M1-00217 的候选 665 边。仍须独立 RG1。能力保持未建立。

sourceRefinements.rationaleEn: Successor M1 delta records Table 6.4.4-1 FIELD-LOAD-PART-NUMBER-NAME as LUR. Shared object LOAD-PART-NUMBER now supports a candidate 665 edge to CRS-M1-00212. Independent RG1 still required.
sourceRefinements.rationaleZh: 后继 M1 增量将表 6.4.4-1 的 FIELD-LOAD-PART-NUMBER-NAME 记为 LUR。共享对象 LOAD-PART-NUMBER 现支持到 CRS-M1-00212 的候选 665 边。仍须独立 RG1。

sourceRefinements.rationaleEn: Successor M1 delta aligns the LUR write triad with §6.3.2 chart A and the TFTP-write machine: DATA-LOADER WRQ to TARGET-HARDWARE, TARGET-HARDWARE ACK to DATA-LOADER, DATA-LOADER DATA to TARGET-HARDWARE. DLA is the loader application layer, not a network WRQ/ACK endpoint. Independent RG1 still required.
sourceRefinements.rationaleZh: 后继 M1 增量将 LUR 写三元组对齐到 §6.3.2 图 A 与 TFTP 写机器：DATA-LOADER 向 TARGET-HARDWARE 发 WRQ，TARGET-HARDWARE 向 DATA-LOADER 发 ACK，DATA-LOADER 向 TARGET-HARDWARE 发 DATA。DLA 是加载器应用层，不是网络 WRQ/ACK 端点。仍须独立 RG1。

sourceRefinements.rationaleEn: 615A 5.3.2.2 requires transferring TFTP options. RFC 2347 §2 is the option-extension mechanism. The edge uses the public retrieval identity, not a fabricated PDF page. It does not claim complete RFC-2347 conformance.
sourceRefinements.rationaleZh: 615A 5.3.2.2 要求传输 TFTP 选项。RFC 2347 §2 是选项扩展机制。该边使用公共检索身份，不伪造 PDF 页码。不声称完整 RFC-2347 符合性。

sourceRefinements.rationaleEn: 615A 5.3.2.3.8.1 is the Blocksize Option Implementation unit already in M1 (CRS-M1-00034) with DEP-RFC-2348. A token search for 'blksize' cannot negate that source. RFC 2348 §2 is the candidate encoding. Capability stays NOT-ESTABLISHED.
sourceRefinements.rationaleZh: 615A 5.3.2.3.8.1 是 M1 已纳入的 Blocksize Option Implementation 单元（CRS-M1-00034）并带 DEP-RFC-2348。不能用 blksize 词形搜索否定该来源。RFC 2348 §2 是候选编码。能力保持未建立。

sourceRefinements.rationaleEn: UPLOAD/INFORMATION option units do not name RFC 1785 negotiation-option advertisement. P7 listings stay with unselected AFDX.
sourceRefinements.rationaleZh: UPLOAD/INFORMATION 选项单元未点名 RFC 1785 协商选项通告。P7 列举仍随未选择的 AFDX。

sourceRefinements.rationaleEn: 615A exception and DLP timers are protocol parameters, not an identified RFC-2349 timeout/tsize option unit.
sourceRefinements.rationaleZh: 615A 异常与 DLP 定时器是协议参数，不是已识别的 RFC-2349 timeout/tsize 选项单元。

sourceRefinements.rationaleEn: P2 physical identity is recorded. No clause-level model target is delivered in this candidate. This remains an incomplete task, not a bounded trace.
sourceRefinements.rationaleZh: 已记录 P2 物理身份。本候选未交付条款级模型目标。这仍是未完成任务，不是有边界追踪。

sourceRefinements.rationaleEn: P3-1 remains a conditional historical input. Independent RG0 still decides edition acceptance. M1 blocksM1Approval snapshot is not flipped.
sourceRefinements.rationaleZh: P3-1 仍为有条件历史输入。独立 RG0 仍决定版次接受。不翻转 M1 blocksM1Approval 快照。

sourceRefinements.rationaleEn: P7 base edition is recorded for deferred AFDX context only.
sourceRefinements.rationaleZh: P7 初版仅作为延期 AFDX 语境记录。

networkRelationDispositions.rationaleEn: 615A 1.3 invokes P3. DD-023 selects its Compliant Network route; P3 exception tables do not replace applicable RFC behavior. Exact-edition acceptance remains an external review decision.
networkRelationDispositions.rationaleZh: 615A 1.3 引用 P3。DD-023 选择其 Compliant Network 路径；P3 例外表不替代适用 RFC 行为。精确版次接受仍由外部评审决定。

networkRelationDispositions.rationaleEn: The current 615A loader fragmentation/reassembly obligation is retained. DD-023 excludes P3 no-reassembly deviations; MTU is a network-size constraint, not an operation deadline.
networkRelationDispositions.rationaleZh: 保留当前 615A 加载器分片／重组义务。DD-023 排除 P3 不重组偏差；MTU 属于网络尺寸约束，并非操作时限。

networkRelationDispositions.rationaleEn: DL-TFTP refers back to 615A; the AFDX example using port 69 does not override 615A port 59.
networkRelationDispositions.rationaleZh: DL-TFTP 回引 615A；使用端口 69 的 AFDX 示例不覆盖 615A 端口 59。

networkRelationDispositions.rationaleEn: P3 names RFC 2347 for base TFTP options; the precise 615A port-option source unit still needs review before a direct RFC edge is emitted.
networkRelationDispositions.rationaleZh: P3 为基础 TFTP 选项列出 RFC 2347；615A 端口选项的精确来源单元仍需评审，之后才可建立直接 RFC 边。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: An ARINC 615A data-loading system may use the batch-file formats defined in 665 §2.3.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: ARINC 615A 数据加载系统可以使用 665 §2.3 定义的批处理文件格式。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: A batch file part shall let the maintainer load the selected LSPs for each target hardware position without picking every LSP individually.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 批处理文件件必须让维护人员按目标硬件位置加载所选 LSP，而不必逐个挑选。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: A batch file part shall be identified with the .LUB extension.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 批处理文件件必须用 .LUB 扩展名标识。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: Header file names referenced in a batch file shall match the case of the actual file names.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 批处理文件中引用的头文件名必须与实际文件名的大小写一致。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: The first three characters of a batch-file name shall be the manufacturer code of the creator.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 批处理文件名的前三个字符必须是创建方的制造商代码。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: The remainder of a batch-file name shall be unique for each batch file defined under that manufacturer code.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 同一制造商代码下每个批处理文件名的其余部分必须唯一。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: A batch-file part number shall be unique within the set of LSP and batch-file parts under the same manufacturer code.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 同一制造商代码下，批处理文件件号必须在 LSP 与批处理文件集合中唯一。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: Header file names referenced in a batch file shall be complete names including extensions and shall omit path references.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 批处理文件中引用的头文件名必须是含扩展名的完整文件名，且不得包含路径。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: Batch files are distributed to onboard and off-board ARINC 615A loaders and are used only to automate multi-LSP setup.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 批处理文件分发给机上和机下 ARINC 615A 加载器，仅用于自动完成多 LSP 设置。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: A batch file part shall not be transferred to target hardware.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 批处理文件件不得传送到目标硬件。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: A batch file shall contain the information defined in Table 2.3.1-1.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 批处理文件必须包含表 2.3.1-1 规定的信息。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: Batch File Length is the number of 16-bit words in the batch file.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 批处理文件长度是该文件中 16 位字的数量。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: A batch-file part number shall follow the software-load PN format in 665 §2.1.1.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 批处理文件件号必须符合 665 §2.1.1 的软件加载件号格式。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: A batch-file part number shall be unique from any LSP part number and any MSP part number.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 批处理文件件号必须不同于任何 LSP 件号和任何 MSP 件号。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: The load-list block pointer of the last load-list block shall be zero.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 最后一个加载列表块的指针必须为零。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: The Target HW ID POS value shall match the THW_ID_POS of the target hardware loaded by this batch file part.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: Target HW ID POS 必须与该批处理文件要加载的目标硬件 THW_ID_POS 一致。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: The header file name shall match the header file of the LSP identified by the Load PN field.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 头文件名必须与 Load PN 字段所标识 LSP 的头文件一致。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: The Load PN shall match the LSP part number to be loaded to that Target HW ID POS.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: Load PN 必须与要加载到该 Target HW ID POS 的 LSP 件号一致。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: The Batch File Format Version field is 16 bits.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 批处理文件格式版本字段为 16 位。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: The Batch File Format Version value shall follow the file-format version definition in 665 §1.4.1.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 批处理文件格式版本取值必须遵循 665 §1.4.1 的文件格式版本定义。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: The spare field shall align the following pointers, which are defined on 4-byte boundaries.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: Spare 字段必须对齐随后按 4 字节边界定义的指针。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: The pointer to Batch File PN Length is an absolute count of 16-bit words from the start of the file.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 批处理文件件号长度指针是自文件起始计的绝对 16 位字数。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: The pointer to Number of Target HW ID Load-List Blocks is an absolute count of 16-bit words from the start of the file.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 目标硬件标识加载列表块数目指针是自文件起始计的绝对 16 位字数。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: Expansion points are where later file-format versions may add new fields.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 扩展点是后续文件格式版本可以新增字段的位置。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: Batch File PN Length is the character count and shall exclude NULs appended to pad an odd character count.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 批处理文件件号长度是字符数，不得计入为补齐奇数长度而追加的 NUL。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: Batch File PN shall be 8-bit ASCII whose character count is given by Batch File PN Length.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 批处理文件件号必须是 8 位 ASCII，字符数由批处理文件件号长度给出。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: The Batch File PN field shall be allocated an even number of bytes.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 批处理文件件号字段必须分配偶数个字节。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: If the Batch File PN character count is odd, append one NUL.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 若批处理文件件号字符数为奇数，则追加一个 NUL。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: Comment Length is the character count and shall exclude NULs appended to pad an odd character count.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 注释长度是字符数，不得计入为补齐奇数长度而追加的 NUL。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: If the batch has no comment, Comment Length shall be zero.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 若该批处理没有注释，注释长度必须为零。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: The Comment field shall be 8-bit ASCII whose character count is given by Comment Length.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 注释字段必须是 8 位 ASCII，字符数由注释长度给出。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: The Comment field shall be allocated an even number of bytes.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 注释字段必须分配偶数个字节。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: If the Comment character count is odd, append one NUL.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 若注释字符数为奇数，则追加一个 NUL。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: If Comment Length is zero, the Comment field shall be omitted.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 若注释长度为零，则必须省略注释字段。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: Number of Target HW ID Load-List Blocks is the count of load-list blocks in the batch file.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 目标硬件标识加载列表块数目是该批处理文件中加载列表块的个数。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: The next load-list-block pointer is a relative count of 16-bit words to the next load-list block.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 下一加载列表块指针是到下一块的相对 16 位字数。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: Target HW ID POS Length is the character count and shall exclude NULs appended to pad an odd character count.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: Target HW ID POS 长度是字符数，不得计入为补齐奇数长度而追加的 NUL。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: Target HW ID POS shall be 8-bit ASCII whose character count is given by Target HW ID POS Length.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: Target HW ID POS 必须是 8 位 ASCII，字符数由 Target HW ID POS 长度给出。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: The Target HW ID POS field shall be allocated an even number of bytes.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: Target HW ID POS 字段必须分配偶数个字节。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: If the Target HW ID POS character count is odd, append one NUL.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 若 Target HW ID POS 字符数为奇数，则追加一个 NUL。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: Target HW ID POS values should stay consistent with the Target HW ID values in the header files of the LSPs listed under that target.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: Target HW ID POS 应与该目标下列出的 LSP 头文件中的 Target HW ID 保持一致。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: Number of Loads for Target HW ID POS is the count of loads in that target's load-list block.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 目标硬件标识的加载数目是该目标加载列表块中的加载个数。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: Header File Name Length is the character count and shall exclude NULs appended to pad an odd character count.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 头文件名长度是字符数，不得计入为补齐奇数长度而追加的 NUL。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: Header File Name shall be 8-bit ASCII whose character count is given by Header File Name Length.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 头文件名必须是 8 位 ASCII，字符数由头文件名长度给出。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: The Header File Name field shall be allocated an even number of bytes.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 头文件名字段必须分配偶数个字节。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: If the Header File Name character count is odd, append one NUL.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 若头文件名字符数为奇数，则追加一个 NUL。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: Header File Name is the file name only and shall omit path information.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 头文件名只含文件名，不得包含路径信息。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: A file name shall not begin with a backslash and shall not contain a backslash.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 文件名不得以反斜杠开头，也不得包含反斜杠。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: File names shall include all extensions and delimiters.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 文件名必须包含全部扩展名与分隔符。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: Load PN Length is the number of characters in the Load PN.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: Load PN 长度是 Load PN 的字符数。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: Load PN Length shall exclude NULs appended to pad an odd character count.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: Load PN 长度不得计入为补齐奇数长度而追加的 NUL。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: Load PN shall be 8-bit ASCII whose character count is given by Load PN Length.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: Load PN 必须是 8 位 ASCII，字符数由 Load PN 长度给出。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: The Load PN field shall be allocated an even number of bytes.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: Load PN 字段必须分配偶数个字节。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: If the Load PN character count is odd, append one NUL.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 若 Load PN 字符数为奇数，则追加一个 NUL。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: When this 664P3 specification conflicts with an applicable RFC, ISO or IEEE standard, 664P3 has precedence. That precedence is not a licence to drop ARINC 615A TFTP option rules.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 当本 664P3 规范与适用 RFC、ISO 或 IEEE 标准冲突时，664P3 优先。该优先不是取消 ARINC 615A TFTP 选项规则的许可。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: On the 664P3 UDP path the End System must be able to generate and check the UDP checksum as tabulated in Table 3.3.2-1.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 在 664P3 UDP 路径上，端系统必须能按表 3.3.2-1 生成并检查 UDP 校验和。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: Implementation of IPv4 in Profiled Networks should comply with Figure 3.4.1-1. ARINC 615A Data Loader fragmentation/reassembly is not erased by that profile.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: Profiled 网络中的 IPv4 实现应符合图 3.4.1-1。该 profile 不抹去 ARINC 615A 数据加载器的分片/重组义务。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: If AFDX is chosen, frames arriving at the switch are filtered for frame integrity, frame length, traffic budget and acceptable destinations. Ordinary Ethernet tests do not prove that switch behaviour.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 若选择 AFDX，到达交换机的帧按完整性、长度、流量预算与可接受目的地过滤。普通以太网试验不能证明该交换机行为。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: If AFDX is chosen, Attachment 2 profile items marked NOT APPLICABLE are interpreted as MUST NOT. That profile does not replace RFC identity or ARINC 615A TFTP rules.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 若选择 AFDX，附件 2 中标为 NOT APPLICABLE 的 profile 项解释为 MUST NOT。该 profile 不取代 RFC 身份或 ARINC 615A TFTP 规则。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: UDP Length is the length in octets of the user datagram including this header and the data.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: UDP Length 是包含本头与数据在内的用户数据报八位组长度。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: UDP Checksum is the 16-bit one's complement of the one's complement sum of the IP pseudo header, UDP header and data, padded to a multiple of two octets.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: UDP 校验和是 IP 伪头、UDP 头与数据的 16 位反码和的反码，必要时填充到二的倍数八位组。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: The minimum UDP Length value is eight octets.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: UDP Length 的最小值为八个八位组。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: IPv4 implements fragmentation and reassembly. ARINC 615A Data Loader fragmentation/reassembly is reconciled with this mechanism and is not erased by 664P3 Profiled deviations.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: IPv4 实现分片与重组。ARINC 615A 数据加载器分片/重组与此机制对账，不被 664P3 Profiled 偏差抹去。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: A datagram whose IP version number is not 4 MUST be silently discarded. Registering this host rule does not establish IPV4-UDP-HOST-COMMUNICATION-SEMANTICS.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 版本号不是 4 的数据报必须被静默丢弃。登记该主机规则并不建立 IPV4-UDP-HOST-COMMUNICATION-SEMANTICS。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: A host MUST verify the IP header checksum on every received datagram and silently discard every datagram that has a bad checksum.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 主机必须验证每个收到数据报的 IP 头校验和，并静默丢弃校验和错误的数据报。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: Every host must support IPv4 reassembly. This is the RFC 1122 host rule; it does not by itself close the project capability register.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 每个主机必须支持 IPv4 重组。这是 RFC 1122 主机规则，本身不关闭项目能力登记。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: A host MUST implement the facility to generate and validate UDP checksums. Registering this rule does not establish IPV4-UDP-HOST-COMMUNICATION-SEMANTICS.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 主机必须实现生成并校验 UDP 校验和的能力。登记该规则并不建立 IPV4-UDP-HOST-COMMUNICATION-SEMANTICS。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: If a UDP datagram is received with a non-zero invalid checksum, UDP MUST silently discard the datagram.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 若收到校验和非零且无效的 UDP 数据报，UDP 必须静默丢弃该数据报。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: TFTP has five packet types identified by Opcode. Lock-step RRQ/WRQ, DATA, ACK and ERROR are the exchanges ARINC 615A file transfer uses.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: TFTP 有五种由 Opcode 标识的包类型。锁步 RRQ/WRQ、DATA、ACK 与 ERROR 是 ARINC 615A 文件传输使用的交换。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: RRQ/WRQ and TID assignment start the TFTP connection ARINC 615A uses. Mail mode is not used.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: RRQ/WRQ 与 TID 分配是 ARINC 615A TFTP 的连接起点。不使用 mail 模式。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: The TFTP header of a packet contains the opcode associated with that packet.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: TFTP 包头包含与该包关联的操作码。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: RRQ and WRQ packets (opcodes 1 and 2) use the Figure 5-1 layout of opcode, filename and mode.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: RRQ 与 WRQ 包（操作码 1 与 2）使用图 5-1 的操作码、文件名与模式布局。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: The RRQ/WRQ file name is a netascii byte sequence terminated by a zero byte.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: RRQ/WRQ 文件名是以零字节终止的 netascii 字节序列。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: DATA packets (opcode 3) have a block number and a data field.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: DATA 包（操作码 3）具有块号与数据字段。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: The DATA data field is from zero to 512 bytes long. RFC 2348 may negotiate a different blocksize; that option is a separate leaf.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: DATA 的数据字段长度为 0 至 512 字节。RFC 2348 可协商不同块大小，该选项是单独的叶。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: An ACK packet has opcode 4 and a block number as in Figure 5-3.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: ACK 包的操作码为 4，并带有如图 5-3 的块号。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: An ERROR packet (opcode 5) has the Figure 5-4 form of error code and netascii message.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: ERROR 包（操作码 5）采用图 5-4 的错误码与 netascii 消息形式。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: A DATA packet containing between 0 and 511 bytes of data marks the end of the transfer.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 包含 0 至 511 字节数据的 DATA 包标志传输结束。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: If a request cannot be granted or an error occurs during the transfer, an ERROR packet (opcode 5) is sent. This is TFTP-layer abort, not a waiver of ARINC 615A FIND clocks, which remain on the FIND rows.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 若请求不能批准或传输中出错，则发送 ERROR 包（操作码 5）。这是 TFTP 层中止，不是对 FIND 行上 ARINC 615A 时钟的豁免。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: OACK acknowledges a client's TFTP option negotiation request. Unimplemented options must not fail the transfer, consistent with this extension.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: OACK 确认客户的 TFTP 选项协商请求。未实现选项不得使传输失败，与此扩展一致。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: Error code 8 indicates that a transfer should be terminated due to option negotiation. ARINC 615A does not invent a different option packet type.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 错误码 8 表示因选项协商应终止传输。ARINC 615A 不另造选项包类型。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: Options append to RRQ/WRQ. Only blksize, timeout and tsize are adopted from RFC 2348/2349 plus any 615A-defined integrity option. Other options stay unimplemented and non-fatal.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 选项附于 RRQ/WRQ。仅采纳 RFC 2348/2349 的 blksize、timeout、tsize 以及 615A 定义的完整性选项。其他选项保持未实现且非致命。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: When blksize is used, the block size in data octets is specified in ASCII and must be between 8 and 65464 inclusive. ARINC 615A may further constrain permitted sizes on its own rows.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 使用 blksize 时，数据八位组块大小以 ASCII 给出，且必须在 8 至 65464（含）之间。ARINC 615A 可在其自有行上进一步约束允许的大小。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: The blksize value is the number of octets in a block, specified in ASCII.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: blksize 值是块中的八位组数，以 ASCII 给出。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: If the server accepts blksize, the OACK value must be less than or equal to the client's requested value.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 若服务器接受 blksize，OACK 中的值必须小于或等于客户请求值。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: The client must either use the blksize in the OACK or terminate the transfer with ERROR code 8.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 客户必须使用 OACK 中的 blksize，或以错误码 8 终止传输。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: When the timeout option is used, the retransmission wait is specified in ASCII seconds from 1 to 255 inclusive. That interval is not the ARINC 615A FIND 2 s host deadline or 3 s registration window, which remain on the FIND rows.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 使用 timeout 选项时，重传等待以 ASCII 秒给出，范围为 1 至 255（含）。该间隔不是 FIND 行上的 ARINC 615A 2 秒主机期限或 3 秒登记窗口。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: If the server accepts the timeout option, the OACK timeout value must match the value specified by the client.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 若服务器接受 timeout 选项，OACK 中的 timeout 值必须与客户指定值一致。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: On RRQ, tsize is requested as 0 and the file size in octets is returned in the OACK. ARINC 615A mismatch handling stays on the 615A rows.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 在 RRQ 上，tsize 请求为 0，文件八位组大小在 OACK 中返回。ARINC 615A 失配处理留在 615A 行上。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: On WRQ, tsize is the file size in octets in the request and is echoed in the OACK.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 在 WRQ 上，tsize 在请求中给出文件八位组大小，并在 OACK 中回显。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: If the RRQ tsize is too large for the client, it MAY abort with ERROR code 3.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 若 RRQ tsize 对客户过大，客户可以错误码 3 中止。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: If the WRQ tsize is too large for the server, it MAY abort with ERROR code 3.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 若 WRQ tsize 对服务器过大，服务器可以错误码 3 中止。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: After blksize is accepted in OACK, a DATA packet shorter than that negotiated blocksize is the final block. A 700-octet DATA after blksize=1024 ends the transfer; a 256-octet DATA after blksize=256 does not.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: blksize 经 OACK 接受后，短于该协商块大小的 DATA 是最后块。协商 1024 后的 700 八位组 DATA 结束传输；协商 256 后的满 256 八位组 DATA 不结束。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: If the file length is an integral multiple of the effective blocksize, an extra DATA packet containing no data is sent to end the transfer. Effective blocksize is 512 when blksize was not accepted, otherwise the OACK value.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 若文件长度是有效块大小的整数倍，须发送不含数据的额外 DATA 包结束传输。未接受 blksize 时有效块大小为 512，否则为 OACK 值。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: An option not acknowledged by the server must be ignored by client and server as if it were never requested. Requesting blksize does not change the 512-octet default until that option is accepted in OACK.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 服务器未确认的选项必须被客户和服务器忽略，如同从未请求。仅请求 blksize 不得改变 512 八位组默认值，直至该选项在 OACK 中被接受。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: The IPv4 Version field is 4 bits wide. 615A TFTP over IPv4 uses this header field.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: IPv4 Version 字段宽 4 位。615A 在 IPv4 上的 TFTP 使用该头字段。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: The IPv4 IHL field is 4 bits wide. 615A TFTP over IPv4 uses this header field.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: IPv4 IHL 字段宽 4 位。615A 在 IPv4 上的 TFTP 使用该头字段。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: The IPv4 Type of Service field is 8 bits wide. 615A TFTP over IPv4 uses this header field.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: IPv4 Type of Service 字段宽 8 位。615A 在 IPv4 上的 TFTP 使用该头字段。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: The IPv4 Total Length field is 16 bits wide. 615A TFTP over IPv4 uses this header field.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: IPv4 Total Length 字段宽 16 位。615A 在 IPv4 上的 TFTP 使用该头字段。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: The IPv4 Identification field is 16 bits wide. 615A TFTP over IPv4 uses this header field.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: IPv4 Identification 字段宽 16 位。615A 在 IPv4 上的 TFTP 使用该头字段。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: The IPv4 Flags field is 3 bits wide. 615A TFTP over IPv4 uses this header field.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: IPv4 Flags 字段宽 3 位。615A 在 IPv4 上的 TFTP 使用该头字段。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: The IPv4 Fragment Offset field is 13 bits wide. 615A TFTP over IPv4 uses this header field.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: IPv4 Fragment Offset 字段宽 13 位。615A 在 IPv4 上的 TFTP 使用该头字段。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: The IPv4 Time to Live field is 8 bits wide. 615A TFTP over IPv4 uses this header field.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: IPv4 Time to Live 字段宽 8 位。615A 在 IPv4 上的 TFTP 使用该头字段。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: The IPv4 Protocol field is 8 bits wide. 615A TFTP over IPv4 uses this header field.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: IPv4 Protocol 字段宽 8 位。615A 在 IPv4 上的 TFTP 使用该头字段。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: The IPv4 Header Checksum field is 16 bits wide. 615A TFTP over IPv4 uses this header field.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: IPv4 Header Checksum 字段宽 16 位。615A 在 IPv4 上的 TFTP 使用该头字段。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: The IPv4 Source Address field is 32 bits wide. 615A TFTP over IPv4 uses this header field.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: IPv4 Source Address 字段宽 32 位。615A 在 IPv4 上的 TFTP 使用该头字段。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: The IPv4 Destination Address field is 32 bits wide. 615A TFTP over IPv4 uses this header field.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: IPv4 Destination Address 字段宽 32 位。615A 在 IPv4 上的 TFTP 使用该头字段。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: TFTP mail transfer mode SHOULD NOT be supported. ARINC 615A file transfer does not use mail mode.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 不应支持 TFTP mail 传输模式。ARINC 615A 文件传输不使用 mail 模式。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: The UDP Length field includes the 8-octet UDP header. This is the RFC 1123 correction of the TFTP/UDP header note.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: UDP Length 字段包含 8 个八位组的 UDP 头。这是 RFC 1123 对 TFTP／UDP 头说明的更正。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: The TFTP DATA sender MUST NOT resend the current DATA packet merely because a duplicate ACK arrived. That is the Sorcerer's Apprentice fix; it is not a FIND-clock rule.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: TFTP DATA 发送方不得仅因收到重复 ACK 而重发当前 DATA 包。这是术士学徒修正，不是 FIND 时钟规则。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: A TFTP implementation MUST use an adaptive retransmission timeout. This is not the RFC 2349 timeout option range and not the ARINC 615A FIND 2 s / 3 s clocks.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: TFTP 实现必须使用自适应重传超时。这不是 RFC 2349 timeout 选项范围，也不是 ARINC 615A FIND 的 2 秒／3 秒时钟。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: A TFTP server SHOULD have configurable access control over allowed pathnames.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: TFTP 服务器应对允许的路径名提供可配置访问控制。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: A TFTP request sent to a broadcast address SHOULD be silently ignored. 615A dataloading does not use broadcast RRQ as a transfer method.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 发往广播地址的 TFTP 请求应被静默忽略。615A 数据加载不以广播 RRQ 作为传输方法。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: If AFDX is chosen, only one End System should be the source of any one Virtual Link.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 若选择 AFDX，任一虚拟链路应只有一个端系统作为源。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: If AFDX is chosen, a Virtual Link is a unidirectional connection from one source End System to one or more destinations.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 若选择 AFDX，虚拟链路是从一个源端系统到一个或多个目的端系统的单向连接。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: If AFDX is chosen, BAG is the minimum interval between the first bits of two consecutive frames of the same VL when scheduler jitter is zero.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 若选择 AFDX，在调度抖动为零时，BAG 是同一 VL 连续两帧首比特之间的最小间隔。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: If AFDX is chosen, the bounded scheduler interval on a VL is the maximum admissible jitter.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 若选择 AFDX，虚拟链路上该有界调度间隔即为最大允许抖动。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: If AFDX is chosen, each VL's maximum usable bandwidth is characterised by BAG and authorised Lmax.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 若选择 AFDX，每条 VL 的最大可用带宽由 BAG 与授权 Lmax 表征。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: If AFDX is chosen, the End System should accommodate VL frames up to 1518 bytes in transmission and reception.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 若选择 AFDX，端系统应在发送与接收中容纳最大 1518 字节的 VL 帧。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: If AFDX is chosen, traffic shaping should handle BAG values from 1 ms to 128 ms.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 若选择 AFDX，流量整形应能处理 1 ms 至 128 ms 的 BAG 值。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: If AFDX is chosen, BAG values are 2^k milliseconds for integer k from 0 through 7.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 若选择 AFDX，BAG 值为 2^k 毫秒，k 为 0 至 7 的整数。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: If AFDX is chosen, VL jitter is bounded at 500 microseconds in all cases. The two-formula max_jitter expression remains a separate hashed-equation gap.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 若选择 AFDX，VL 抖动在所有情况下以 500 微秒为界。双公式 max_jitter 表达式仍是单独的方程缺口。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: If AFDX is chosen, a Virtual Link is identified only by the MAC destination address; the MAC source is the unicast address of the physical interface.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 若选择 AFDX，虚拟链路仅由 MAC 目的地址标识；MAC 源地址是物理接口的单播地址。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: IPv4 IHL is the internet header length in 32-bit words and points to the beginning of the data.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: IPv4 IHL 是以 32 位字计的互联网头长度，并指向数据起点。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: A correct IPv4 header has IHL at least 5.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 正确的 IPv4 头的 IHL 至少为 5。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: IPv4 Total Length is the datagram length in octets, including internet header and data.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: IPv4 Total Length 是包含互联网头与数据在内的数据报八位组长度。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: IPv4 Fragment Offset is measured in units of 8 octets (64 bits).
objectConstraints.predicateZh: IPv4 Fragment Offset 以 8 个八位组（64 位）为单位。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: IPv4 options may appear or not in a datagram. That presence is variable; it is not a fixed-width header field.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: IPv4 选项可以在数据报中出现或不出现。该出现是可变的，不是固定宽度头字段。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: IPv4 header padding makes the internet header end on a 32-bit boundary. Padding width is therefore variable.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: IPv4 头填充使互联网头结束于 32 位边界。因此填充宽度是可变的。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: If AFDX is chosen, the End System's main function is to provide services that guarantee secure and reliable data exchange to the partition software.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: 若选择 AFDX，端系统的主要功能是向分区软件提供保证安全可靠数据交换的服务。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: IPv4 implements addressing and fragmentation as its two basic functions.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: IPv4 实现寻址与分片两项基本功能。

objectConstraints.predicateEn: RFC 1123 section 4.2 adds host TFTP notes. ARINC 615A uses octet TFTP with its own option set; mail is prohibited by 4.2.2.1, netascii stays out of profile, and broadcast requests are silently ignored rather than used as a transfer method.
objectConstraints.predicateZh: RFC 1123 第 4.2 节补充主机 TFTP 说明。ARINC 615A 使用带自有选项集的 octet TFTP；mail 由 4.2.2.1 禁止，netascii 保持出配置，广播请求被静默忽略而不是用作传输方法。

IF_TFTP.noteEn: Does not reconstruct the full TFTP/IPv4 stack.
IF_TFTP.noteZh: 不重建完整 TFTP/IPv4 栈。

IF_TFTP_BLOCKSIZE.noteEn: 615A 5.3.2.3.8.1 requires Data Loader block-size / network-interface capability. RFC 2348 §2 is the candidate option encoding. Capability remains NOT-ESTABLISHED.
IF_TFTP_BLOCKSIZE.noteZh: 615A 5.3.2.3.8.1 要求数据加载器具备块大小／网络接口能力。RFC 2348 §2 是候选选项编码。能力仍为未建立。

IF_NETWORK.noteEn: Compliant IPv4/UDP host service is a premise for Project Configuration.
IF_NETWORK.noteZh: Compliant IPv4/UDP 主机服务是 Project Configuration 的前提。

sequenceConstraints.noteEn: Figure 6.3.2 A requires list accept and LUR transfer before file RRQ.
sequenceConstraints.noteZh: 图 6.3.2 A 要求在文件 RRQ 之前完成列表接受与 LUR 传输。
INFORMATION 的 LCL 列表先于 LCS 状态。

model.stepSemanticsEn: Delay grows clocks in C; variables stay unchanged; invariants hold. A discrete step binds the input event's typed payload, evaluates the guard (PAYLOAD names read that payload, not implicit variable writes), then updates, then resets matching clock instances, then outputs, then the target. Timeout and WAIT-elapsed events are enabled only by COMPARE(enablingCompare) between enablingClock and enablingBound. The input event is the stimulus; outputs are additional emissions and must not repeat the stimulus as a second message.
model.stepSemanticsZh: 延时时 C 中时钟增长，变量不变，不变量成立。离散步骤先绑定输入事件的有类型 payload，再求值守卫（PAYLOAD 名读取该 payload，不是隐式变量写入），然后更新、复位匹配的时钟实例、输出，进入目标。超时与 WAIT 到期事件仅由 enablingClock 与 enablingBound 之间的 COMPARE(enablingCompare) 使能。输入事件是刺激；输出是额外发射，不得把刺激再计为第二条报文。

infrastructurePremises.behaviorEn: The underlying IPv4/UDP service must satisfy applicable IETF host requirements without P3-specific deviations. Retained as an infrastructure prerequisite; neither implementation compliance nor a complete RFC requirements inventory is claimed. M2 must plan its substantiation before any execution configuration is approved.
infrastructurePremises.behaviorZh: 底层 IPv4/UDP 服务须遵循适用 IETF 主机要求，不采用 P3 特有偏差。此项作为基础设施前提保留；未声称实现符合性或完整 RFC 需求清单。M2 须规划其验证，之后才可批准任何执行配置。
infrastructurePremises.acceptanceEn: Independent review of a Project Configuration that names the host stack and applicable RFC subset.
infrastructurePremises.acceptanceZh: 对指明主机栈与适用 RFC 子集的 Project Configuration 做独立评审。

infrastructurePremises.behaviorEn: Only host requirements actually triggered by the IPv4/UDP path. RFC 1123 does not replace RFC 1122.
infrastructurePremises.behaviorZh: 仅纳入当前 IPv4/UDP 路径真实触发的主机要求。RFC 1123 不替代 RFC 1122。

actions.noteEn: CR-2026-011 executed the successor identities (6.4.4 LUR, 6.4.5 LUS, LUR write endpoints DL WRQ / TH ACK / DL DATA). Independent RG1 still required. This is a bounded M2 baseline, not a development-ready CRS.
actions.noteZh: CR-2026-011 已执行后继身份（6.4.4 为 LUR、6.4.5 为 LUS、LUR 写端点为 DL WRQ／TH ACK／DL DATA）。仍须独立 RG1。这是有界 M2 基线，不是开发就绪 CRS。

actions.noteEn: RFC-2347 option transfer and RFC-2348 block-size are candidate edges; 1785/2349 remain without an active 615A unit.
actions.noteZh: RFC-2347 选项传输与 RFC-2348 块大小为候选边；1785/2349 仍无活动 615A 单元。

actions.noteEn: Attachment 4 equation restored with retry terms; clocks enable timeout transitions.
actions.noteZh: 已恢复带重试项的附件 4 方程；时钟使能超时迁移。
未执行 requirementKind 分类扩展。

actions.noteEn: FIND CRS candidates exist under CR-2026-012; bound M2 still does not model FIND. MODEL-REFINEMENT-PENDING.
actions.noteZh: CR-2026-012 下已有 FIND CRS 候选；绑定 M2 仍不建模 FIND。模型精化待定。

actions.noteEn: AFDX CRS candidates exist as conditional deployment; bound M2 remains unselected. MODEL-REFINEMENT-PENDING.
actions.noteZh: AFDX CRS 候选为条件化部署；绑定 M2 仍未选择 AFDX。模型精化待定。

actions.noteEn: P2 identity only; no clause-level model target.
actions.noteZh: 仅有 P2 身份；无条款级模型目标。

actions.noteEn: Owner accepted 664P3-1 as this M2 input edition; 664P7 remains recorded and AFDX stays unselected.
actions.noteZh: 所有者接受 664P3-1 作为本 M2 输入版次；664P7 保持已登记且 AFDX 未选。
IPv4/UDP 验证计划用于 Configuration。
完整性能力保持未建立。
未选择的 AFDX 寻址保持延期。

actions.noteEn: M1 merge facts remain in inputAcceptance.
actions.noteZh: M1 合并事实仍在 inputAcceptance。

actions.noteEn: Successor M1 delta executed under CR-2026-011. Frozen merge bytes stay unchanged as a preserved record. Independent RG1 still required.
actions.noteZh: 后继 M1 增量已在 CR-2026-011 下执行。冻结合并字节作为保留记录不变。仍须独立 RG1。

actions.noteEn: After 6.4.4→LUR there is no dedicated LUI field table. LUI remains a sequence file. Fields are not invented.
actions.noteZh: 6.4.4 改为 LUR 后没有专用 LUI 字段表。LUI 仍是序列文件。不编造字段。

analysisScope.finiteDomainEn: Control states are finite. File payloads are abstracted to named field predicates, length and direction. Symbolic timers remain symbolic. Step semantics are defined; timed reachability is not proved.
analysisScope.finiteDomainZh: 控制状态有限。文件载荷抽象为具名字段谓词、长度和方向。符号定时器保持符号。已定义步语义；未证明定时可达。

discreteWitnesses.summaryEn: UPLOAD init accept: payload.decision=ACCEPT enables the branch; lastDecision is written after the guard.
discreteWitnesses.summaryZh: UPLOAD 初始化接受：payload.decision=ACCEPT 使能该分支；守卫求值后再写入 lastDecision。

discreteWitnesses.summaryEn: UPLOAD init reject from payload.decision=REJECT starting at lastDecision=NONE.
discreteWitnesses.summaryZh: 从 lastDecision=NONE 起，payload.decision=REJECT 使能 UPLOAD 初始化拒绝。

discreteWitnesses.summaryEn: INFORMATION init accept uses the same typed payload, not a pre-written lastDecision.
discreteWitnesses.summaryZh: INFORMATION 初始化接受使用同一有类型 payload，而不是预先写好的 lastDecision。
INFORMATION 初始化拒绝来自 payload.decision=REJECT。

discreteWitnesses.summaryEn: After init accept the list is not yet offered; LUR WRQ is not enabled.
discreteWitnesses.summaryZh: 初始化接受后列表尚未提交；LUR WRQ 不能使能。

discreteWitnesses.summaryEn: After the list is offered but before LUS-0001, LUR WRQ stays disabled.
discreteWitnesses.summaryZh: 列表已提交但尚未收到 LUS-0001 时，LUR WRQ 仍不能使能。

discreteWitnesses.summaryEn: LUS-0001 establishes session-local list readiness; only then DL WRQ LUR, TH ACK and DL DATA are enabled.
discreteWitnesses.summaryZh: LUS-0001 建立会话内列表就绪；此后才使能数据加载器 LUR WRQ、目标硬件 ACK 与数据加载器 DATA。

discreteWitnesses.summaryEn: A later UPLOAD start after INFORMATION completion clears list readiness; offering the list still does not enable LUR WRQ.
discreteWitnesses.summaryZh: INFORMATION 完成后再启动 UPLOAD 时清除列表就绪；提交列表后 LUR WRQ 仍不能使能。

discreteWitnesses.summaryEn: WAIT retry is disabled while CLK_WAIT is below MESSAGE_TIMER_VALUE and enabled at the closed lower bound.
discreteWitnesses.summaryZh: CLK_WAIT 低于 MESSAGE_TIMER_VALUE 时禁止 WAIT 重试；到达闭下界后才使能。

discreteWitnesses.summaryEn: Accept is not enabled by lastDecision alone; missing payload.decision leaves the guard false.
discreteWitnesses.summaryZh: 仅有 lastDecision 不能使能接受；缺少 payload.decision 时守卫为假。

blockingInputs.noteEn: Successor M1 delta executed under CR-2026-011. Frozen merge bytes stay unchanged. Independent RG1 still required.
blockingInputs.noteZh: 后继 M1 增量已在 CR-2026-011 下执行。冻结合并字节不变。仍须独立 RG1。

blockingInputs.noteEn: Successor M1 LUR write endpoints are DATA-LOADER→TARGET-HARDWARE WRQ, TARGET-HARDWARE→DATA-LOADER ACK, DATA-LOADER→TARGET-HARDWARE DATA. Frozen merge bytes stay unchanged.
blockingInputs.noteZh: 后继 M1 的 LUR 写端点为 DATA-LOADER→TARGET-HARDWARE WRQ、TARGET-HARDWARE→DATA-LOADER ACK、DATA-LOADER→TARGET-HARDWARE DATA。冻结合并字节不变。

blockingInputs.noteEn: Owner accepted 664P3-1 as this M2 input edition; 664P7 remains recorded and AFDX stays unselected.
blockingInputs.noteZh: 所有者接受 664P3-1 作为本 M2 输入版次；664P7 保持已登记且 AFDX 未选。
